summary: Independent review confirms that the frozen specification is based on the actual target main at 220242b1. The initialized candidate currently contains only its task ledger. The POSIX design addresses the ordering of trusted os.defpath aliases, keeps non-default Git discovery after those directories, and preserves Windows literal path behavior, the environment allowlist and the strict original and resolved executable checks. The reproducible POSIX acceptance, fresh native V1 evidence, independent implementation review and exact-head Linux required check adequately cover the change. Transfer and merge remain limited to the authorized repository and reviewed single branch.
